# Country scope. O(1) check whether this country operates an Imperial Company, Chartered Bank, or Overseas Exarchate.
oe_eco_v97_has_bank_or_company = {
	exists = international_organization:oe_byz_bank_org
    OR = {
        oe_cmp_has = yes
        any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_bank }
        is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_bank_org
        oe_far_has_east_exarch = yes
        oe_far_has_west_exarch = yes
    }
}

# Country scope. Eligible to issue Imperial Sovereign Bonds through Eurasian clearing hubs.
oe_eco_v97_bond_eligible = {

    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        oe_eco_v97_has_bank_or_company = yes
        current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
    }
}

# Country scope. Eligible to activate Imperial Grain Price Stabilization in hub markets.
oe_eco_v97_grain_eligible = {

# Country scope. True when active sovereign bond service is stressed by high inflation or severe war exhaustion.
oe_eco_v97_bond_stress = {
    has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_bond_service
    OR = {
        inflation >= 0.15
        war_exhaustion >= 6
    }
}

oe_eco_v97_cycle_host = {
